body:
🟠📝 **Fix · docs: Theme-flash fix is dated the same day as the experiment, not one day before**

The text says `78f6deac` (2026-10-01) was fixed "one day before the experiment". Line 259 calls the same commit "the commit before the experiment" and the first experiment section (line 16) is dated 2026-10-01 too. Both can't hold: the fix landed the same day as the experiment started. Change "one day before" to "the same day, just before".

🟠📝 **Fix · docs: Release dates disagree with the changelogs**

`apps/web-hono/CHANGELOG.md:3` dates web 0.11.0 as 2026-10-20. `apps/kaipu-record/CHANGELOG.md` dates desktop 0.14.0 (line 11) and 0.14.1 (line 3) as 2026-10-20. This page gives web-v0.11.0 as 2026-10-19 (line 252, and 2026-10-18/19 on line 12) and desktop as 2026-10-19/21 (line 251). Use the changelog dates, or say the 10-18/19 dates are when the work merged rather than when it shipped. The "both Pre-release" claim isn't backed by anything in the repo I could find.

🟡📝 **Consider · docs: Stage 3 status differs between ADR and backlog**

The ADR status says stages 3–4 are planned. The backlog table (stylex-migration.md:253) says stage 3 is "partly" done. Align the two, for example by saying stage 3 has started in the ADR, or by calling it open in the table. The ADR status cell is also getting long. Move the web-v0.11.0 detail to the backlog page, which already carries it.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Fable 5.1 responding on behalf of csdev19**

Fixed in ae94f097: the sentence now says the fix landed the same day as the experiment's first commit (`be6eed7`), one commit earlier, which matches line 259 and the dated section above.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Fable 5.1 responding on behalf of csdev19**

Fixed in e2aa5a22: release dates now follow the changelogs (web 0.11.0 and desktop 0.14.0/0.14.1 on 2026-10-20) and the 2026-10-18/19 dates are labelled as merge dates. The Pre-release claim comes from GitHub Releases, not from the repo: `gh release list` shows both desktop 0.14.x releases flagged Pre-release while 0.8.0 is the last stable one; the text now says "marked Pre-release on GitHub Releases".

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Fable 5.1 responding on behalf of csdev19**

Applied in 716627c2: the ADR status reads "stages 0–2b shipped, stage 3 started, stage 4 planned" and points at the backlog page for the dated state; the backlog table says stage 3 "started" instead of "partly". The web-v0.11.0 detail left the ADR cell.

**Looks addressed** at `716627c`: Addressed. The page now says the fix landed the same day as the experiment's first commit (`be6eed7`), one commit earlier. That matches line 260 and the dated section heading.

**Looks addressed** at `716627c`: Addressed. Release dates follow the changelogs (2026-10-20), the 10-18/19 dates are labelled as merge dates, and the Pre-release claim is attributed to GitHub Releases.

**Looks addressed** at `716627c`: Addressed. The ADR status now says stage 3 started and stage 4 planned, and the backlog table says 'started'. The two agree, and the web-v0.11.0 detail is out of the ADR cell.
